Subject: Need help with a maritime salvage claim case

Hello, my name is Sanjay Tiwari. I am a 44-year-old bank manager living in New Delhi. Our salvage crew rescued a vessel owned by Crescent Shipping Pvt Ltd and we claim Rs 5,09,00,000, and the vessel is about to leave port. My case number is A.S. No. 1097/2021 in the Delhi High Court. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on +91 94167 63924 or email sanjay.tiwari28@example.com.
